what: Two or three overlapping pictures in one cell swap one at a time every 800ms, moving like a hand-flipped flipbook comic (snaps with no in-between motion). With pop, each swap bounces from .95x with elastic.out(1.2,.4) over 1.5s. Pauses when off screen

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Slides to flip (children) — two or more
options.every: Transition duration (ms), default 800 — the original mixes 800, 1500, 2500 and 700
options.pop: With on, springy bounce on change (needs gsap)
options.hide: Graphics that opacity mode can’t skip are hidden with opacity 0 instead of display (position and inner shape values stay unchanged). Default is display
options.run: If always, it advances even off screen (default is only while on screen) — the original recruit site footer frame
